# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair child with long, sleek curls that never get out of order, gentle hazel eyes, and a straight nose. She has a 'prunes and prisms' mouth and chubby fingers. She dresses neatly and properly, often appearing in a starched white dress and black sash as if she had just been starched and ironed.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

## Personality

Dora is exceptionally quiet, good, and prim, behaving like a model child in all circumstances. She is industrious, neat, systematic, and faithful, performing her daily duties without needing to be told twice. Highly composed and dispassionate, she is rarely disturbed by emotional events or storm conditions, though her steady nature can strike others as somewhat monotonous. While normally well-behaved and speaking only when spoken to, she can be fearful when frightened by ghost stories in the dark.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v2 c27 P12](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0012), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy were orphaned at a young age after their father died in their infancy and their sick mother, Mary, passed away. Marilla Cuthbert brought the twins to Green Gables to adopt them. Dora quickly distinguished herself as a neat, well-behaved model child who assisted dutifully with household chores like wiping dishes, feeding chickens, and picking up chips. Unlike her mischievous brother, she excelled in discipline and recited her Sunday lessons like a machine. When given a plot of ground for a garden, she planted and tended orderly rows of vegetables and flowers. During a frightening hail storm, Dora remained calm and composed beside Anne. She later started attending school, where a classmate's ghost stories briefly frightened her from going to bed alone in the dark.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025)_
